THE IDEA BEHIND MORETIME

A bill is paperwork.
You’re a person.

The planned iMessage experience starts with your situation, then helps you prepare your next move.

01

Send the confusing part.

A photo or PDF of your notice. We’ll help identify the amount and dates, and check what’s unclear.

02

Tell us what’s realistic.

Your budget matters. Explore options supported by verified provider policies, with your circumstances in view.

03

Go in with a plan.

Prepare what to say, track offers and requested documents, and keep the next step in sight.

You don’t need all the answers.
Just somewhere to start.
